nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the JARVIS read-only FastAPI backend, installing Python dependencies from requirements.txt and launching the app via uvicorn on port 8000 with Neo4j credentials injected at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build using python:3.12-slim; NEO4J_* env vars are injected at runtime by docker-compose or the host environment, not baked into the image.
